observations: Photo 0 shows a large bed with a padded headboard featuring a grid of rectangular tufted sections, accented with horizontal gold-colored strips. The bed is dressed with a blue plaid bedsheet. A teal-colored padded footboard is visible in the foreground. Two bedside tables with lamps are on either side.

Photo 1 shows the same bed from a slightly different angle, revealing the side of the bed frame, which is upholstered in the same grey fabric as the headboard. The mattress is covered with a blue plaid sheet with pink and light blue stripes. The floor is tiled, and the room has brown curtains.
The headboard is wide and extends to the wall, matching the seller's description of an 'extended padded wall-panel headboard'.
The footboard is also padded and upholstered, matching the headboard in style and fabric.
No brand or model markings are visible on the bed frame or headboard in either photo.
The bed appears to be a custom-made upholstered bed frame set, not a branded or mass-produced model.

claims.claim: Custom upholstered 6x6 King Size bed frame set
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a large bed with upholstered headboard and footboard, consistent with a custom-made king size frame. The '6x6' likely refers to dimensions in feet, which is typical for king size beds in Nigeria.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the headboard extending across the wall width, with padded, tufted sections and gold trim, matching the description.

risks.risk: The bed frame may be structurally weak or poorly constructed, especially if made with low-quality wood or metal supports.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the bed frame's internal structure, including the legs, slats, and joints, from underneath or side view.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or requiring reinforcement

risks.risk: The upholstery fabric may be low-quality or prone to fading, staining, or tearing.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the fabric texture and stitching, showing material quality and any signs of wear or damage.

risks.risk: The mattress is not included, but the seller may imply it is part of the set.
risks.proof: A clear statement from the seller confirming whether the mattress is included or not, or a photo showing the mattress being removed or not part of the frame.
risks.if_unproven: priced as frame only, excluding mattress

proof_requests: Close-up of the bed frame's internal structure (legs, slats, joints) to verify sturdiness.
Close-up of the upholstery fabric to assess quality and condition.
Confirmation from the seller whether the mattress is included in the sale.
response.reason: The item is clearly a custom upholstered king size bed frame set with an extended padded headboard and footboard, as described. The photos support the seller's claims. While there are hidden risks regarding structural integrity and fabric quality, these do not prevent pricing — the item can be priced at its worst case (e.g., as potentially unstable or low-quality fabric). The identity is clear by type, and no brand/model is needed for pricing in this market.
